report.summary: All four failures share one root cause: the app's list_books() sleeps for a random 0-8 seconds (app/main.py:150), and the UI test fixture caps page operations at 5 seconds (tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7). Any test that loads /books, directly or via the post-register redirect, times out whenever the sleep runs past about 5 seconds. Fix this first by removing the injected delay from list_books, or at least making it deterministic; no test code needs to change for that.

causes.title: Random server-side delay in list_books() exceeds the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database. The /books page renders through render_books(), which calls list_books(), so every load of /books waits 0-8 s on the server. The UI tests set page.set_default_timeout(5000) in the autouse fixture, so Page.goto('/books') gives up at 5 s, and roughly 3 in 8 loads should exceed that. The registration test is affected the same way: clicking Register succeeds, but POST /register redirects to /books, and the click waits for that navigation ('waiting for scheduled navigations to finish') until it times out. Each failure is a 5000 ms timeout, consistent with this. The outcome depends on chance, so the same commit can pass on a rerun. This is not a product bug in the sense of wrong behavior: the page renders correctly, just slowly and at random. The sleep looks like test-only latency injection that was left in production code.
evidence: app/main.py:150: time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))  (inside list_books, which is called on every /books render)
app/main.py:287-297: POST /register calls create_user, then logged_in_redirect(...) which returns RedirectResponse("/books", 303)
tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7: page.set_default_timeout(5000) with docstring 'Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s'

test_added_book_is_listed: playwright TimeoutError: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63061/books", waiting until "load" (tests/support/pages.py:34, tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:10)

test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... 'click action done' then 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' (tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:9, tests/support/pages.py:22)
No product-side error appears anywhere in the failure output; every failure is a timeout, not an assertion about page content.
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) line from list_books() in app/main.py:150. If the delay is needed to simulate slowness for some other test, make it an explicit, opt-in setting that is off by default (for example an env var read at startup), and keep it out of the default test app. Do not raise the 5 s default timeout to hide it. If a slow-page scenario must stay covered, give that single test its own explicit timeout. Then rerun the UI tests several times to confirm they pass consistently.
